# GC-MS: from peak to identity — data appendix

**Illustrative schematic panels — no real compound.** The chromatogram and the stick spectra are drawn from the made-up parameters below. The axes carry **no numbers** on screen (retention time and m/z are unitless positions 0–12 and 0–100); nothing here is a retention time, m/z or relative abundance of any real substance, and the video does not claim to identify one.

## 1. Chromatogram

signal(t) = baseline + Σ hᵢ · exp(−½ ((t − rtᵢ)/wᵢ)²), baseline ≈ 0.02 with a small ripple.

| Peak | rt (unitless) | height | width | colour | apex signal (computed) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 3.6 | 0.62 | 0.18 | amber | 0.6424 |
| B | 6.4 | 0.95 | 0.22 | coral | 0.9692 |
| C | 9.1 | 0.45 | 0.26 | beam | 0.4722 |

## 3. Paths drawn over the app's schematic

Carrier-gas, ion and signal paths are polylines in the drawing's own coordinates (`storyboard.json → data.paths`), traced from `tool/illustrations/schematic/mass_spec_gc.svg` (cf. `tool/video/lessons/anim_gc_ms.js`). They show order, not geometry of any instrument.
